offence_note: Attempted murder, aggravated assault, firearm offences; co-accused dangerous driving
co_offenders: Furber: 3 years for firearm possession (28 months after credit), 60 days concurrent dangerous driving
sentence_quote: On Count 1 of the indictment, the attempted murder of Andrew Morton, I sentence you to eight years without credit for the five months you have spent in custody on that.
note: Joint submission accepted; other counts concurrent; Furber also 2 year driving prohibition.

sentence_quote: The appellant was sentenced to six months’ imprisonment, followed by two years of probation.
note: Leave to appeal dismissed; only the $300 victim surcharge vacated on consent.

sentence_quote: I am sentencing you to a sentence of four and a half years, for which you have credit for pretrial custody of 26 months and six days, leaving a sentence of 27 months and four days to be served.
note: Remaining time later corrected orally to 27 months and 24 days; offender on parole; no Gladue report.

offence_note: Attempted murder; aggravated assault and s.88 stayed
sentence_quote: The sentence of this Court is that you be incarcerated for a period of 60 months. That is five years, less credit for remand time on the basis of 1.5. That is, 22 months. Total sentence is 38 months.
note: Convicted by jury; excerpts do not show mitigating findings.

sentence_quote: set aside the sentence of two years, replace it with a conditional sentence of two years less a day and impose on terms and conditions as set out by the material placed before us by the Crown and impose a 10 year fire arms prohibition.
note: Two years custody replaced by conditional sentence; 10 year s.109 prohibition.

offence_note: Aggravated sexual assault, choking to enable sexual assault, unlawful confinement
sentence_quote: I so order 15 years for aggravated sexual assault; 4 years for choking running concurrently and 2 years for unlawful confinement concurrent with the first charge.
note: No further remand credit given; offender separately declared dangerous offender on other charges; s.743.6 order.

offence_note: Child abduction, two break and enters, possession of stolen property
sentence_quote: He was sentenced for these offences to a determinate sentence of 59 ½ months' incarceration with ten years' supervision, credit having been given on a 1:1 basis for 26 ½ months' pre-sentence custody.
note: Appeal only on credit rate; dismissed. Other mitigating: no violence, returned child unharmed.

sentence_quote: I sentence you to life imprisonment for the second degree murder of Tsz Yeung Wong.
note: Joint submission of 10 years parole ineligibility; victim surcharge waived; minimum security recommended.

offence_note: Sexual assault causing bodily harm, robbery, choking, confinement, uttering threats
sentence_quote: I sentence you to an overall prison term of four-and-a-half years, or 54 months, in respect of all counts to run concurrently.
note: Only 24 of 34 months available credit applied; rest left for Provincial Court sentencing; ancillary orders not shown.
